name: Spokane River (Spokane – Plese Flats)
blurb: City-to-state-park run under the bluffs of Riverside State Park, with Bowl and Pitcher's basalt rapids.

sections.notes: Mostly Class II with two Class III rapids (AW). Spring runoff flows are big and dangerous. AW lists the reach as 6.8 mi; access mileages give ~6.5. Discover Pass required at Riverside State Park (Plese Flats).
